(San Francisco) is an independent, YC W24-backed open-source task-orchestration/workflow-engine startup founded by Alexander Belanger (CEO, ex-Porter S20 co-founder/CTO) and Gabriel Ruttner (CTO, ex-ClearMix S20). The YC company page (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/hatchet-run) confirms the same domain hatchet.run, batch W24, status Active. No press-confirmed funding or revenue figures were located within the search budget; funding ($500K seed) and revenue (~$440K ARR) are third-party aggregator estimates (Tracxn/Crunchbase/GetLatka via search snippets), not company-confirmed. Company states in its own blog it generates 'significant revenue from our cloud version' without disclosing a number, and moved to usage-based pricing in 2026.
